pages.text: Check every drop for affixes and sockets. Apotheosis runs the pack's loot, enchanting, spawner, and potion overhauls from Tier 1 on.

$(bold)Enchanting overhaul:$() Structure loot holds no enchanted books. Your bookshelf tiers decide your enchantment pool, and the anvil's 'Too Expensive' cap is gone.$(br2)$(bold)Gem sockets:$() Affix items have gem sockets. Gems scale from Flawed (T1) to Perfect (T4), and the Gem Cutting Table stays locked until T2.

$(bold)Affix system:$() Weapons and armor roll random stats, from Common (T1) to Mythic (endgame). The Reforging Station rerolls affixes for tokens.$(br2)$(bold)Spawner overhaul:$() You can upgrade Apotheosis spawners (speed, range, spawn caps), and farming spawners is a fair way to progress.

$(bold)No in-game guidebook.$() JEI tooltips and these Codex entries explain Apotheosis:$(br2)$(li)$(l:icraft:systems/apotheosis_enchanting)Apotheosis Enchanting$(/l)$(li)$(l:icraft:systems/affixes)Apotheosis Affixes$(/l)$(li)$(l:icraft:loot/gems)Apotheosis Gems$(/l)$(br2)$(bold)Next: kill a glowing Apotheosis boss and check its drops.$()
